details: CONFIRMED by probe. In setup(), d = detect(root) runs before kit.toml exists; the first-setup branch writes
bindings_text(d, ...) (now with d["worktrees"]) but never refreshes d["bindings"]; ensure_gitignore at :990
uses that stale d. gitignore_lines (:680-690) only looks at d["bindings"]["project"]["worktrees"] and defaults
to ".worktrees". Before this change kit.toml and .gitignore agreed (both wrong); now they disagree. No test
covers the .gitignore half. Size: 15 agent minutes.
evidence: probe.py (temp git repo, bin/wt: git worktree add ".worktree/$1"):
folder = project.get("worktrees") if isinstance(project, dict) else None
folder = folder if isinstance(folder, str) and folder.strip("/") else ".worktrees"
failing_case: A git project with no .claude/kit.toml whose bin/wt runs `git worktree add ".worktree/$1"` (ALIX's shape).
relay setup: detect() gives d["bindings"] = {} and d["worktrees"] = ".worktree"; kit.toml is written with
worktrees = ".worktree"; d is not reloaded, so ensure_gitignore(root, d) -> gitignore_lines(d) finds no
[project] worktrees and falls back to ".worktrees". .gitignore gets ".worktrees/" (a folder nobody uses) and,
when it lacks it, never gets ".worktree/" - linked worktrees then show as untracked. The item's title and failing
case name both halves ("writes worktrees = .worktrees and ignores .worktrees/"); only the kit half is fixed.
fix_hint: In gitignore_lines fall back to d.get("worktrees", ".worktrees") instead of the literal ".worktrees" (or reload
